name: Lantern Loft
description: An original isometric loft contains eight sliding modules with raised walkways, walls and stairs. Slide modules into the empty rail, then carry the lantern across physically joined surfaces to the glowing exit landing.
natural_language: Rebuild the loft path and carry the lantern to the glowing exit landing. Screen-space overlap is not a passage: use matching elevations and visible stairs.

metadata.variant_count_kind: three original palettes × eight isometric board orientations × two mirrored arrangements
metadata.notes: Visible module elevations, openings, stair markings, rail positions, hit testing and independent replay use one generated 3D contract. The browser does not receive the hidden route plan; a solver uses it only as ordinary-input oracle evidence.
